children: Lucid Diagnostics announced regulatory and coding progress that supports expanded Medicare billing and tracking for EsoGuard and EsoCheck.
CMS advisory panel recommended maintaining gapfill payment basis for EsoGuard (PLA 0114U); final determinations expected in November.
AMA CPT Editorial Panel approved a new Category III CPT code for nonendoscopic esophageal cell collection using EsoCheck.
CDC/NCHS ICD-10 committee responded favorably to proposed diagnosis code R85.83 for positive EsoGuard methylated DNA results.
Lucid will begin submitting Medicare claims under PLA 0114U from its Texas lab this month and from its California lab once revised LCD is effective.

title: Lucid Diagnostics advances payment, billing and coding for EsoGuard and EsoCheck
